Primary button: your #7c3aed is the fill itself, with white text at 5.70:1; hover is primary-600 and pressed is primary-700.

Hue check: your hex is unchanged at primary-500 and as --color-brand, and every step aims at its exact hue; lightness follows the fixed steps and saturation eases toward the palest and darkest steps, and steps 400 to 700 are never more colourful than your colour. Rounding to hex moves the hue of the primary scale at most 0.04° at steps 300 to 800 and 0.3° at the palest and darkest steps. The four status scales are the skill's standard default scales.

### How to use
- Load tokens.css before your own styles. 
- Without a data-theme attribute the page follows the system setting; set data-theme="light" or data-theme="dark" on the html element to force one.
- Spacing: 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 px. Type sizes: 12, 14, 16, 20, 24, 30, 36 px, body 16 px, line-height 1.5. Weights: 400 and 600.
- Controls: 36, 44, 52 px high; every click or tap area at least 44 px. Breakpoints: 640, 768, 1024, 1280 px (copy the numbers into media queries).
- Brand colour on at most 5% of a screen: primary action, focus ring, selected item background.
- Font: the system font stack. No font files, imports or links.
